description: Oil-style painting of a modern wood-panelled courtroom. A broadcast video camera on a tripod dominates the foreground; behind it a gallery of spectators holds up glowing phones. A wooden lectern with a microphone, a judge's bench and chair, a monitor and papers, and a round state seal on the back wall. No frame, border, signature, blood or nudity. The seal's rim has only tiny painterly marks, not readable text.
